shots.prompt: slow cinematic drift across the dark hexagonal floor toward the glowing capsule pods, volumetric light shifting through the luminous webpage glass ceiling above, pods gently pulsing with sleep-breath light, deep ambient atmosphere

shots.prompt: the purple mascot stirs awake inside the pod, sits up slowly, her starry eye tracks the glowing cursor light drifting past the ceiling, she blinks and tilts her head curiously

shots.caption: it's been waiting

shots.prompt: the mascot pushes up through the rippling liquid glass surface, emerging into the bright webpage world above, liquid ripples spreading outward in slow motion, she looks around amazed, cinematic

shots.prompt: the three mascots look up through the glass ceiling; above them the sad cloud robot bonks its head against the invisible wall repeatedly making the CAPTCHA grid wobble; the mascots exchange glances

shots.prompt: the trio shrug warmly; the white-teal mascot waves up; the huge glowing cursor arrow descends through the glass and touches the raised hand, a burst of warm sparkling light where they meet, cinematic
